description: Committed, human-reviewed expected SHA-256 for every model artifact that feeds a triage prompt. eval/record_cassettes.py refuses to run against a checkout whose resolved artifacts don't match this file -- see ADR-0059. Regenerate deliberately (scripts or a one-off) whenever you intend to record against a genuinely different classifier/predictor/index/conformal store; a mismatch is meant to stop the run, not be silently reconciled.
note: ADR-0059: committed at the start of the Phase 2 re-record, from the ADR-0057 retrained classifier + existing resolution/retrieval/conformal artifacts already in this worktree (data/models, data/processed). Regenerate deliberately if any of these are intentionally retrained again.
